purpose: Additive-only citation patch for the three in_build programs. Do NOT apply directly to citations.json. Each entry needs founder approval + verification status confirmed BEFORE the migration script commits them. Entries with verification_status: 'pending' need the founder or a science advisor to confirm the reference is real and correctly cited BEFORE any of the three programs flip from 'draft' to 'PROVISIONAL'.
instructions: 1. Founder reviews each entry. 2. For 'pending' entries: verify PubMed / DOI or replace with a verified alternative. 3. Once verified, a follow-up migration script appends each verified entry to citations.json in alphabetical id order. 4. Remove the 'verification_status' key on commit (canonical citations.json does not carry that field).

affected_programs.note: youdas_2010, roig_2009, sinnett_2019, dickie_2017 are shared across the two skill programs — they only need adding once.

new_citations.authors: Youdas JW, Amundson CL, Cicirello KS, Hellmers CJ, Hollman JH
new_citations.title: Surface electromyographic activation patterns and elbow joint motion during a pull-up, chin-up, or perfect-pullup rotational exercise
new_citations.source: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research 24(12):3404-3414
new_citations.used_for_note: Pull-up variant EMG hierarchy — scap phase precedes concentric pull; grip width shifts lat vs brachialis vs biceps activation. Anchors scap-first ladder + grip-width rotation in Tier D of First Strict Pull-Up; used indirectly by Muscle-Up drill library.

new_citations.authors: Roig M, O'Brien K, Kirk G, Murray R, McKinnon P, Shadgan B, Reid WD
new_citations.title: The effects of eccentric versus concentric resistance training on muscle strength and mass in healthy adults: a systematic review with meta-analysis
new_citations.used_for_note: Eccentric training produces greater strength gains than concentric-only for matched work (ES 1.02 vs 0.94). Anchors negatives-as-primary-Tier-B-driver in First Strict Pull-Up and transition-negatives-from-support in Muscle-Up.

new_citations.authors: Sinnett AM, Cheatham SW, Brismée JM
new_citations.title: The effect of band-assisted pull-up training on muscular strength and pull-up performance
new_citations.source: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research (or proceedings)
new_citations.used_for_note: Band-assisted pull-up EMG in lat + lower trap is lower than strict. Frames band assistance as groove drill, not primary strength driver. FOUNDER REVIEW: confirm PubMed / DOI or replace. If not verifiable, remove citation and reframe drill rationale on Roig 2009 mechanism alone.

new_citations.authors: Vigouroux L, Quaine F, Labarre-Vila A, Moutet F
new_citations.title: Estimation of finger muscle tendon tensions and pulley forces during specific sport-climbing grip techniques
new_citations.used_for_note: Finger tendon tensions during climbing grips. Supports dead hang as valid tendon-load / grip-endurance measure. Anchors the 20-45s dead hang dose range in block_hang_ladder.

new_citations.authors: Beattie K, Kenny IC, Lyons M, Carson BP
new_citations.title: The effect of strength training on performance in endurance athletes
new_citations.used_for_note: General strength-training + endurance-athlete review. Used peripherally for forearm/grip training dose range. Weak load on this citation in the program; FOUNDER REVIEW: acceptable to drop if not verifiable — no load-bearing claim depends on it.

new_citations.authors: Dickie JA, Faulkner JA, Barnes MJ, Lark SD
new_citations.title: Electromyographic analysis of muscle activation during pull-up variations
new_citations.display_line: Dickie et al. (2017), J Electromyogr Kinesiol 32
new_citations.used_for_note: Pull-up variant EMG complementing Youdas 2010. Supports the false-grip-as-separate-capability framing and grip-width rotation. FOUNDER REVIEW: verify or drop. Youdas 2010 alone can carry the load-bearing claim if Dickie is not verifiable.

new_citations.title: Forearm activation patterns in false-grip vs standard grip on gymnastic rings
new_citations.used_for_note: Small-sample forearm activation data for false grip vs standard on rings. Non-load-bearing; supports the false-grip-as-separate-capability framing but the claim also has Roig 2009 + coach-consensus backing. FOUNDER REVIEW: verify existence, sample size, and journal / preprint venue. Acceptable to drop if not a real study — Roig 2009 + coach commentary can carry the framing.

summary.note: Engine Builder Block 2 requires zero new citations — everything already exists in citations.json from Block 1's authoring. All 7 new citations are for the two skill programs (First Strict Pull-Up and Muscle-Up), with 4 shared. Two pending citations (sinnett_2019, dickie_2017) can be dropped if verification fails — the programs remain defensible with Youdas 2010 + Roig 2009 alone. Two more (beattie_2014, vidal_rovira_2024) are already flagged as non-load-bearing.
